sources.title: IRS Publication 551 (12/2025), Basis of Assets
verifiedClaims: IRS states that accurate records of items affecting basis must be kept.
IRS states that basis of property purchased is usually its cost, while other costs and individual situations may alter the analysis.

scopeAndLimitations: No bullion-specific tax classification or reporting conclusion is asserted.
Shipping, listed insurance, and seller or carrier terms are described as transaction records only, not proof of coverage.
Readers are directed to current IRS guidance and a qualified tax professional for application to their own facts.
